name: sup-abstain-baseline-missing
notes: The only series-mate of current `C` (selector `[]`, the whole inventory) is `N` (selector `['src']`), a narrower run. `selectorRelation(N.selector, C.selector)` decides `'subset'` -- the relation is fully determined and it is not a superset, so `N` is never a candidate (no unknown involved). With zero candidates and no unknown relation, `previous-superset` abstains `baseline-missing`/`determined`: a decided non-candidate never falls back to a weaker match (§5.3), unlike `baseline-missing` never carries `near_miss` (that disclosure is `previous-comparable`-only, §5.4).
